subject: CascadePoint post-signature adoption schedule & canary rehearsal
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@cascadepoint.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Johnson <eric.j@cascadepoint.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature: adoption timeline & canary rehearsal

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for a productive week — excited to get started. As we close the contract this week, the executive team asked for a concise post-signature operational plan we can share with our engineering and SRE teams. Specifically they want: a mutual action plan (high-level milestones + owners), the evaluation plan for the canary (success criteria, rollback thresholds), and a close-to-live timeline (migration windows, training dates).

We have the availability to run a canary rehearsal the week of July 6th but need a confirmed window and a rehearsal checklist so our SREs can run through the steps. Also confirm whether Redwood will provide temporary test tokens and a small traffic generator for the rehearsal.

I've attached a short internal ops note on CascadePoint's side (ops@cascadepoint.com) and our preferred 2-week training window in July.

Can you send over a draft MAP and the canary checklist by end of day Thursday so we can route it to procurement and SRE?

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Director, Cloud Ops
CascadePoint

Attachment: cascadepoint-internal-ops-note.txt (text, 4KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@cascadepoint.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Eric Johnson <eric.j@cascadepoint.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature: adoption timeline & canary rehearsal

Hi Marta / team,

Great — congrats on signing. Attached is a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP_CascadePoint_v1.xlsx) and a short Canary Rehearsal Checklist (PDF) with explicit success/rollback criteria. Summary below; please treat as a working doc we can edit during tomorrow's alignment call.

High-level MAP (milestones + owners):
- T0 (Contract signed): Contract countersigned, SOW posted to shared drive — Owner: Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood) / Marta A. (CascadePoint) — Target: 2026-06-24
- Provisioning & Access (Day 1–3): VPC peering, test tokens, initial capacity reservation (2x dedicated GPU nodes) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / CascadePoint Ops — Target: 2026-06-26
- Canary Rehearsal (Week of Jul 6): Dry-run with synthetic traffic, smoke tests, performance gates — Owner: SRE leads (both sides) — Target window: 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-09
- Staged Migration (Week of Jul 13): 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic ramp with acceptance at each gate — Owner: Deployment leads — Target: 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-16
- Training & Handover (Jul 20–23): Ops runbook, troubleshooting playbook, train-the-trainer session (2 x 2-hr sessions) — Owner: Laura Bennett (Redwood) / CascadePoint Eng — Target: 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-23
- Post-migration Eval (30 days): Latency/cost/quality monitoring and two retrospective checkpoints — Owner: Customer Success — Target: through 2026-08-23

Canary evaluation plan (key gates):
- Metrics: 99th percentile latency <= 250ms, token cost variance <= 15% of benchmark, error rate < 0.5%
- Quality: automated regression tests against 250 prompt cases; pass rate >= 95%
- Rollback triggers: sustained error rate > 0.5% for 5m, P99 latency spike > 1s for 10m, or quality regression > 10% on any critical prompt set

Requested artifacts we will deliver before rehearsal:
- Test tokens and temp credentials (Redwood)
- Small traffic generator container image (we can provide)
- Canary rehearsal checklist (attached)

Action items for CascadePoint: please confirm SRE participant list and preferred rehearsal window (we've penciled Jul 6–9). Also confirm whether the training sessions should be recorded and posted to your internal LMS.

Links / scheduling:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CP-2026-0457
- Draft MAP (attached): MAP_CascadePoint_v1.xlsx (tabbed: milestones, owners, acceptance)
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/CP-0457 (signed)

I'll follow up internally to confirm capacity and will loop Ben for provisioning.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_CascadePoint_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB); Canary-Rehearsal-Checklist.pdf (pdf, 46KB); Scheduling-ops-slots.csv (csv, 3KB)

Hi Marta — thanks for the note. For the training block (Jul 20–23) we typically run two 2-hour sessions (AM technical deep-dive; PM runbook + troubleshooting). Can you confirm if CascadePoint prefers early-PST or mid-day ET windows? If your team prefers recorded-only or asynchronous, we can compress to a single 3hr recorded session but recommend at least one live Q&A.

Also: if you prefer, we can move the final acceptance gate to Jul 17 (one day earlier) provided the canary passes on Jul 9 and there are no outstanding regressions. Please confirm and we'll update the MAP table.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@cascadepoint.com>

Stephanie / team — this looks good, thank you. CascadePoint confirms Jul 6–9 for the canary rehearsal; ops will provide two SREs (Eric Johnson and Priya Singh) and a test account with limited data. We prefer early-PST training windows (10:00–12:00 PST) for the live sessions; please schedule the two live sessions on Jul 20 and Jul 21 and record the final runbook session for our LMS.

We also accept the provisioning plan for 2 GPUs and would like the acceptance gate moved to Jul 17 if the rehearsal passes without issues. I've uploaded a short internal sign-off doc to your shared link and assigned the procurement reviewer — they expect the finalized MAP + checklist by Friday COB.

Thanks — looking forward to the rehearsal.

Marta Alvarez
Director, Cloud Ops
CascadePoint
